description: HOW THE x402 CATALOGUE ANSWERS, AS A WHOLE. We knock a few catalogued endpoints a minute all day with the unpaid first half of the x402 handshake (the same knock `test_purchase` rehearses, never a payment): endpoints somebody has paid first, then priced ones, one knock per host per minute, robots.txt honoured. This returns the summary: how many endpoints answered as a server, did not, or quoted a different price from their own listing at their last knock; how much of the catalogue was knocked in the last 24 hours and ever, and how many days one pass takes at the pace; what the last run did; and one row a day for thirty days. Alive means a server answered (402, 405, 401/403 or 200), not that it delivers. Before the first run `ran` is false and the figures are null, never zero. Each endpoint’s own last knock is `lastSweep` on its row in `list_x402_endpoints`. FREE.
name: x402_sweep

answerLead.description: SINCE 2026-11-28: at most three lines before the full answer, from its own fields: `text`, `result`, `risks` (up to two), `asOf`, `coverage`, `unknowns` (up to two) and `deprecatedFields` (legacy duplicates this answer still carries). The full answer governs. Added by this MCP server; the REST route behind the tool does not carry it.

coverage.description: catalogue, knockedLast24h, knockedEver, passDays (days one full pass takes at this pace).

history.description: One row a UTC day, oldest first, at most thirty: day, knocked, alive, dead, unsure, changedPrice.

latest.description: Over every endpoint we have knocked, from its last knock: alive, dead, unsure, changedPrice of compared.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

ran.description: False before the first run, when every figure is null.

run.description: The last run: knocked, alive, dead, unsure (throttled by our pace), changedPrice of compared, byTier {paid, priced, rest}, skippedRobots, skippedCooling, stoppedByBudget.

says.description: The reading in a sentence, with its denominators and what a knock does not establish.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

title: How the x402 catalogue answers
